overloadMerges.note: Draft parser produced two separate overloads (one per doc syntax line): one requiring a leading '*' with object hard-typed as Text, the other with object hard-typed as Variable/Field and no '*'. Docs describe this as a single command whose object parameter is a Text/Variable/Field union selected by the optional leading '*' flag (same mechanism as OBJECT Get help tip and the ~167-command star_operator_dual_signature family), so merged into one overload with that union type and a discriminatedBy rule on '*'.

params.description: If specified, object is an object name (Text).

params.name: object
params.description: Object name (if '*' is specified) or a Variable/Field reference (if '*' is omitted).

discriminatedBy.rule: When '*' is passed, object is an object name (Text) identifying the target by name; when '*' is omitted, object must be a direct Variable or Field reference.

constraints: Returns True if the object was printed entirely, False otherwise (e.g. not enough room left on the page).
